svg.title: An image is a grid of numbers: one plane for a grey picture, three planes for a colour one
svg.desc: Left, the 6 by 6 cover as numbers, 9 for the bright hollow square and 0 elsewhere, with a small pixel picture of it; right, the colour version as red, green and blue planes of the top-left 4 by 4 corner.
